vote.question: [US-AK - U.S. Senate]: Dan Sullivan (R) has received $24,726,126 in career campaign contributions (with $11,508,274 this cycle, alongside $47,145,763 in outside Super PAC support led by Senate Leadership Fund (SLF PAC))—linked to "Extractive Energy & Petrochemical Capture". Do you vote to formally rebuke Dan Sullivan for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent his constituents by upholding his core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet Dan Sullivan has amassed $24,726,126 in career contributions (with $11,508,274 this cycle, alongside $47,145,763 in outside Super PAC support led by Senate Leadership Fund (SLF PAC))—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure Dan Sullivan on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

question_vars.lead_patron_clause: with $11,508,274 this cycle, alongside $200,000,000 in outside Super PAC support led by MAGA Inc.

options: Yes — Formally Rebuke & Direct Escrow to Local Restitution
No — Reject Rebuke & Direct Escrow to Public Commons

outcomes.YES_RELEASE_TO_LOCAL_CHARITIES: Directs 100% of the funds to verified local non-profits working directly on state community needs.
outcomes.NO_RELEASE_TO_COMMUNITY_COMMONS: Directs 100% of the funds to bipartisan, universal local public services (volunteer fire/EMS, veterans' care, food banks, disaster relief).

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

Verified local recipients: ALASKA WILDLIFE CONSERVATION CENTER INC (US-EIN:920170600); ALASKA CONSERVATION FOUNDATION (US-EIN:920061466); GREAT LAND TRUST INC (US-EIN:920155014); TYONEK TRIBAL CONSERVATION DISTRICT (US-EIN:270671847); COPPER RIVER WATERSHED PROJECT (US-EIN:920162546). Once the pool hits $10,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-AK with clean IRS status and direct community impact. trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).

bounty_if_no_wins.description: Community Commons for US-AK: If residents decide against the restitution fund, 100% of the funds go directly to essential local community services in US-AK (Volunteer Fire/EMS, Veterans' Care, Food Banks, and Disaster Relief).
